name: Navigation
summary: Glass navbar with brand mark, pill-style links, scroll shadow, and mobile responsive behavior.
structurePatterns: Full-width glass bar with backdrop-filter blur
Pill-shaped nav links with azure accent on hover/active
Scroll state adds bottom shadow and reduces opacity
Brand logo/wordmark on left, links center/right, optional actions

structures.name: Default Navbar
structures.description: Top navigation bar with glass background, pill links, and brand lockup.
notes: Active page uses accent background on pill
Maintains 44px minimum touch targets for links

structures.name: Scrolled Navbar
structures.description: Navbar state after page scroll, with stronger glass effect and bottom shadow.
notes: Adds .scrolled class via JS on scroll
Stronger opacity and subtle bottom border
Shadow depth increases with scroll distance

structures.name: Mobile Navbar
structures.description: Responsive navigation for narrow viewports with collapsible menu.
notes: Drawer slides in from right or expands vertically
Links stack vertically in mobile layout
